overview_description.description:
Affibay is a technology-driven performance marketing and advertising infrastructure platform focused on AI-powered campaign optimization and scalable digital customer acquisition.

The company develops advanced software solutions that help brands, advertisers, and publishers manage and optimize high-volume marketing campaigns using machine learning, automation, and real-time analytics.

Affibay's platform integrates multiple traffic sources, affiliate networks, and advertising channels into a centralized system that provides intelligent campaign tracking, predictive performance insights, and automated optimization tools.

By leveraging artificial intelligence and cloud-based infrastructure, Affibay enables businesses to scale global marketing operations efficiently while improving traffic quality, conversion performance, and return on advertising spend.

The company is also expanding into AI-driven marketing automation, large-scale data processing, and cloud-native infrastructure designed to support high-performance workloads for advertising analytics and marketing intelligence.

Affibay serves partners across e-commerce, digital advertising, affiliate marketing, and performance marketing industries worldwide.
